title: The Next Conversation
author: Jefferson Fisher
blurb: Jefferson Fisher is a Texas trial lawyer who became widely known for short videos about everyday communication. In this book he argues that most of us treat disagreements as contests to win, and that this approach damages relationships and rarely solves anything. He suggests aiming instead for a better next conversation, one where both people can keep talking. His approach rests on three ideas. First, control yourself before you try to manage the exchange, using things like breathing and pausing to stay steady. Second, speak with confidence by choosing clear, direct words and setting boundaries without apologising for them. Third, focus on connection by getting curious about what the other person actually means and needs. The result is a practical guide for handling tense moments at work and at home with less drama and more understanding.
